events.title: A First Look at Antiquity: Our Village Is Becoming a City
events.summary: Hello everyone! We're excited to share a first look at Antiquity in Pixel Metropolis. In this new dev diary, we start with a Metal Age settlement and show how new households, building materials and services begin to turn it into a city. This is a preview of work in progress for the full game. The free demo currently covers the Paleolithic, Neolithic and Metal Age. events.title: State of the Game — Demo, Next Fest, and What Comes Next
events.summary: With Steam Next Fest approaching, this feels like a good time to take stock of where Pixel Metropolis is today and where development is heading next.The current demo lets you guide a settlement from the Paleolithic, through the Neolithic, and into the Metal Age.
